package console

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/tucats/govax/internal/cpu"
	"github.com/tucats/govax/internal/rms"
	"sort"
)

func TestSurvey84Build(t *testing.T) {
	out := os.Getenv("SURVEY_OUT")
	if out == "" {
		t.Skip()
	}
	dir := os.Getenv("HOME") + "/Documents/Technical Doc/VMS/dungeon-3.2A"
	d, c, buf := shareFindConsole(t, false)
	path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "big.dsk")
	if err := c.cmd().InitializeContainer(path, 60000, "BIG", 0, "RD54"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := d.Dispatch(`MOUNT DUA3: "` + path + `"`); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := d.Dispatch("SET DEFAULT DUA3:[000000]"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	put := func(host, name string) {
		text, err := os.ReadFile(host)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if _, err := c.ContainerSession.CreateRecordFile(rms.FileLocation{Name: "DUA3:[000000]" + name}, rms.TextRecords, splitSource(string(text))); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(name, err)
		}
	}
	put(filepath.Join(dir, "dparam.for"), "DPARAM.FOR")
	for _, n := range []string{"dungeon", "game", "gdt", "objects", "parser", "rooms", "subr", "timefnc", "verbs"} {
		u := strings.ToUpper(n)
		put(filepath.Join(dir, n+".f"), u+".FOR")
		buf.Reset()
		err := d.Dispatch("FORTRAN/CONTINUATIONS=40 " + u)
		o := buf.String()
		fmt.Printf("== FORTRAN %s err=%v, %d bytes of messages\n", u, err, len(o))
		// message identifiers only: never the source text
		seen := map[string]int{}
		for _, l := range strings.Split(o, "\n") {
			if strings.HasPrefix(l, "%") {
				id, _, _ := strings.Cut(l, ",")
				seen[id]++
			}
		}
		fmt.Println(seen)
		if err == nil {
			if mx := os.Getenv("SURVEY_MARX"); mx != "" {
				put(filepath.Join(mx, "dungeon-"+n+".marx"), u+".MAR")
			}
			recs, _, e := c.ContainerSession.ReadRecordFile(rms.FileLocation{Name: "DUA3:[000000]" + u + ".MAR"}, rms.TextRecords)
			if e == nil {
				var b strings.Builder
				for _, r := range recs {
					b.Write(r)
					b.WriteByte('\n')
				}
				os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, "dungeon-"+n+".marx"), []byte(b.String()), 0o600)
			}
			buf.Reset()
			err = d.Dispatch("MACRO " + u)
			fmt.Printf("   MACRO err=%v said %d bytes\n", err, buf.Len())
			if buf.Len() > 0 {
				fmt.Println(firstLine(buf.String()))
			}
		}
	}

	// the data files
	raw, _ := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, "dtext"))
	var recs [][]byte
	for i := 0; i+80 <= len(raw); i += 80 {
		recs = append(recs, raw[i:i+80])
	}
	if _, err := c.ContainerSession.CreateRecordFile(rms.FileLocation{Name: "DUA3:[000000]DTEXTV.DAT"}, rms.VariableRecords, recs); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	put(filepath.Join(dir, "dindx"), "DINDX.DAT")
	put(os.Getenv("SURVEY_KIT")+"/mkdtx.for", "MKDTX.FOR")
	put(os.Getenv("SURVEY_KIT")+"/itime.for", "ITIME.FOR")
	buf.Reset()
	for _, l := range []string{"FORTRAN MKDTX", "MACRO MKDTX", "LINK MKDTX", "RUN MKDTX", "FORTRAN ITIME", "MACRO ITIME", "LINK/EXECUTABLE=DUNGEON DUNGEON,GAME,GDT,OBJECTS,PARSER,ROOMS,SUBR,TIMEFNC,VERBS,ITIME"} {
		err := d.Dispatch(l)
		fmt.Printf("%s: err=%v said=%q\n", l, err, firstLine(buf.String()))
		buf.Reset()
	}
	for _, script := range []string{"quit", "game"} {
		input, _ := os.ReadFile(os.Getenv("SURVEY_KIT") + "/" + script + ".in")
		c.In = strings.NewReader(string(input))
		counts := map[uint32]int64{}
		names := map[uint32]string{}
		cpu.SurveyProfile = func(pc uint32, dec *cpu.Decoded) {
			if counts[pc] == 0 {
				names[pc] = dec.Instruction.Name
			}
			counts[pc]++
		}
		_, r0, w0, mr0, mw0 := c.Engine.Memory().Stats()
		got := shareRun(t, d, buf, "DUNGEON")
		cpu.SurveyProfile = nil
		_, r1, w1, mr1, mw1 := c.Engine.Memory().Stats()
		os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, "dungeon-"+script+".printedx"), []byte(got), 0o600)
		var rep strings.Builder
		var total, nmain, nftn, ns0, nother int64
		byOp := map[string]int64{}
		byRoutine := map[string]int64{}
		var dbg = c.ImageState(nil).FindMainICB()
		var ftnLo, ftnHi uint32
		for _, icb := range c.ImageState(nil).ICBList {
			if icb.Name == "FTNRTL" {
				ftnLo, ftnHi = icb.Base, icb.End
			}
		}
		for pc, n := range counts {
			total += n
			switch {
			case pc >= dbg.Base && pc < dbg.End:
				nmain += n
				byOp[names[pc]] += n
				name := "?"
				if dbg.Debug != nil {
					if r, _, ok := dbg.Debug.RoutineAt(pc); ok && r != nil {
						name = r.Name
					}
				}
				byRoutine[name] += n
			case pc >= ftnLo && pc < ftnHi:
				nftn += n
			case pc >= 0x80000000:
				ns0 += n
			default:
				nother += n
			}
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(&rep, "script=%s lines=%d printed=%d total=%d main=%d ftnrtl=%d s0=%d other=%d reads=%d writes=%d code=%d\n", script, strings.Count(string(input), "\n"), len(got), total, nmain, nftn, ns0, nother, r1-r0+mr1-mr0, w1-w0+mw1-mw0, dbg.End-dbg.Base)
		list := func(m map[string]int64, top int) {
			var ks []string
			for k := range m {
				ks = append(ks, k)
			}
			sort.Slice(ks, func(i, j int) bool { return m[ks[i]] > m[ks[j]] })
			for i, k := range ks {
				if i == top {
					break
				}
				fmt.Fprintf(&rep, "  %-14s %11d %5.1f%%\n", k, m[k], 100*float64(m[k])/float64(max(nmain, 1)))
			}
		}
		list(byOp, 20)
		if script == "quit" {
			type hp struct {
				pc uint32
				n  int64
			}
			var hs []hp
			for pc, n := range counts {
				if pc >= ftnLo && pc < ftnHi {
					hs = append(hs, hp{pc, n})
				}
			}
			sort.Slice(hs, func(i, j int) bool { return hs[i].n > hs[j].n })
			for i := 0; i < 16 && i < len(hs); i++ {
				fmt.Fprintf(&rep, "FTN %8d +%06X %s\n", hs[i].n, hs[i].pc-ftnLo, names[hs[i].pc])
			}
		}
		list(byRoutine, 14)
		fmt.Print(rep.String())
		os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, "dungeon-"+script+".profx"), []byte(rep.String()), 0o600)
	}
}
